settings.title: सेटिंग्ज
platform.hero.title: Climate evidence, in the time it takes to read this line.
platform.hero.sub: Senseible turns any business document into a verified emission record — one that a lender can underwrite, a regulator can audit, and a buyer can rely on.
platform.what.title: A verification layer for climate data.
platform.what.body: Most climate numbers are self-reported. Senseible replaces the self-report with a chain of evidence — a hash, a methodology, a confidence band — that anyone downstream can independently check. It works on the documents a business already produces, in the language and the country the business already operates in.
platform.who.title: Six audiences. One verified record.
platform.who.msme.label: MSMEs & exporters
platform.who.msme.line: Turn invoices into a verified emission record — no consultant required.
platform.who.enterprise.label: Enterprises
platform.who.enterprise.line: Get Scope 3 supplier data that holds up under CBAM, ISSB and CSRD.
platform.who.lender.label: Banks & lenders
platform.who.lender.line: Underwrite against hash-pinned figures, not borrower self-declarations.
platform.who.policy.label: Policy & regulators
platform.who.policy.line: Read decision-grade signals tied to a methodology version you can audit.
platform.who.buyer.label: Carbon credit buyers
platform.who.buyer.line: Source MSME-origin credits that clear additionality and evidence linkage.
platform.who.partner.label: Ecosystem partners
platform.who.partner.line: Plug verified MSME climate data into your own product surface.
platform.problem.title: The verification gap in emerging-market climate data.
platform.problem.p1: Emerging-market supply chains carry most of the world's industrial emissions, and almost none of the verified data. Regulators ask for primary numbers. Buyers ask for primary numbers. Lenders ask for primary numbers. Without them, the default values apply — and the cost lands on the smallest producer.
platform.problem.p2: Senseible closes that gap by making verification cheap enough to do at the speed of business, in the language and identifier system of every market it touches.
platform.how.title: Three steps. Same record, used three ways.
platform.how.capture.title: Capture
platform.how.capture.body: Drop a document, take a photo, or speak the data point. The first response arrives in under two seconds.
platform.how.verify.title: Verify
platform.how.verify.body: Every document is hashed, parsed, classified deterministically, and reconciled against country grid factors.
platform.how.use.title: Use
platform.how.use.body: The verified record feeds your disclosure, your lender, your reduction roadmap, and — when eligible — your credits.
platform.out.eyebrow: What you can do with verified data
platform.out.title: Four outcomes, one ledger.
platform.out.report.title: Report
platform.out.report.body: One verified ledger serves CBAM, BRSR, GHG Protocol, ISSB, CSRD, TCFD, GRI and SBTi without re-keying.
platform.out.finance.title: Finance
platform.out.finance.body: Verified baselines and a Climate Credibility Score become underwriting inputs for green loans and factoring.
platform.out.decarbonize.title: Decarbonize
platform.out.decarbonize.body: A baseline becomes a sector-aware roadmap. Reductions are tracked against the original methodology, not re-baselined.
platform.out.monetize.title: Monetize
platform.out.monetize.body: Records that clear additionality, evidence linkage and methodology lock can become credit-ready signals for buyers.
platform.trust.title: Trust, in one line.
platform.trust.body: Every figure carries its SHA-256 evidence hash, its methodology version, its confidence band, and a Climate Credibility Score from A+ to D.
platform.industries.title: Built for the sectors that need it most.
platform.where.title: Ten markets, each with its own identifier and grid factor.
platform.cta.title: Two ways to start.
platform.cta.body: Try the verification surface with your own document. Or talk to the team about embedding it in yours.
